units: pixels and seconds; image x right, y down; t = frame / 24; angles in degrees counter-clockwise from image +x (right), i.e. 90 = image up

camera.evidence: phase correlation of sidewalk regions vs frame 0: max shift 0.008 px over all 72 frames
camera.view: top-down (bird's-eye) view of a street intersection; no visible perspective (straight parallel curbs, identical repeated fixtures have identical pixel sizes on both sides), so one px-to-world scale for the whole ground plane

car.description: peach / cream sedan seen from above, the only vehicle and the largest moving object
car.reference_point: cx,cy = centroid of the tight body mask (paint + convex hull, shadow excluded); taken as the car's origin (Blender object origin at body centre). front_x/y and rear_x/y = bumper midpoints along the body axis

size_px.note: length/width from PCA extents of the body mask (bumper to bumper, mirror to mirror ~ incl. 1-2 px blur); minAreaRect len/wid ~1 px smaller (217-219 x 79-81). With soft shadow included (car_with_shadow.csv) ~222 x 91.

car.motion: stationary frames 0-1, then drives up (image -y) along the vertical road while turning right, ends heading right (+x) along the horizontal road. Centroid step is nearly constant (mean 6.83 px/frame frames 2-71, sd ~0.18), heading rotates from 89.8 deg (frame 1) to ~0 deg (frame 66+)

cyclist.description: person riding a bicycle, seen from above (thin dark figure: wheels in front and behind, rider shoulders/arms at middle), the small object moving straight up the left lane of the vertical road at x ~918
cyclist.reference_point: cx,cy = centroid of the difference mask (rider + bicycle, includes faint shadow). Frames 0-2 flagged occluded=1: car's shadow touches the mask, cx biased ~+2-3 px

size_px.note: length oscillates 57-65 px with the pedalling; frames 0-2 widened by the car shadow

cyclist.motion: stationary frames 0-1, from frame 2 moves straight up (direction 90 +- 2 deg) at an almost constant rate (mean 8.93 px/frame frames 2-71; per-frame centroid steps jitter 7.5-10.3 px because of the pedalling legs)

static_objects._note: measured on the temporal-median background (frames/bg.png); bbox = [x0, y0, x1, y1] inclusive pixels; sizes axis-aligned (all are axis-aligned in the image) unless stated

road_vertical.note: between the curbs of the left and right sidewalk blocks, +-5 px

sidewalk_top_left.note: beige block with rounded corner and darker curb

manhole_dark_square.description: dark grey square grate/manhole with red-brown rim on top-right sidewalk

brown_square_top_left.description: brown textured square (tree pit / planter) on top-left sidewalk

street_lamps.description: eight identical lamp fixtures seen from above (two round grey heads ~13 px plus a round base joined by a thin arm); span ~55-75 px

corner_fixtures.description: dark grey boxy fixtures (traffic-signal / utility box like) near each corner of the intersection

teal_round_object.description: small teal round object (bollard / hydrant / bin) on bottom-right sidewalk

white_ball.description: white sphere lying on the horizontal road near the right edge; does not move

rock_cluster.description: cluster of 3 grey rocks on the horizontal road near the right edge, below the ball; does not move

events.event: car and cyclist both stationary (frames 0 and 1 are identical)
motion start of car and cyclist (first displacement is frame 1 -> 2)
car starts rotating right (heading 89.8 at f1, 89.1 at f3, 88.5 at f4, then ~1-2.5 deg/frame)
car heading within 1 deg of horizontal (turn essentially finished)
car heading 0 deg (aligned with horizontal road), keeps driving right to the end
car passes the cyclist's x without contact: closest approach in frames 0-2 (gap between car body left edge x~950 and cyclist right edge x~930 ~ 20 px); no collision, no contact in the clip

files.tracks/car_with_shadow.csv: car per frame from the loose difference mask (body + soft shadow), for reference only
